h1:
Where to Stay in Phayao?
12 Hotels We Actually Reviewed
Prices Compared Across 3 Sites!
heroSub: 12 hand-picked Phayao hotels across every budget — from lakeside boutiques with pools by Kwan Phayao to town-centre hotels within walking distance of the lake and budget dorms. Covering the Kwan Phayao lakeside, the town centre and the Chiang Kham side. From roughly ฿250–1,800/night.
introH2: 🏞️ Why does choosing the right area in Phayao matter so much?
introHtml: Phayao is a small, quiet town built around Kwan Phayao, a large freshwater lake in the heart of the city. Stays fall into three areas with very different feels — the lakeside at Ban Tom is quiet, with lake views, boutiques and resorts with pools; the town centre puts you within walking distance of the Chai Kwan lakefront road, the markets and Wat Tilok Aram's pier, ideal if you don't have a car; and Chiang Kham district sits about an hour away, handy for Wat Nantaram and Phu Sang. Many people book without checking the area and end up driving back and forth all day. This guide rounds up 12 hand-picked Phayao hotels across every tier — all with real guest reviews, prices compared across 3 sites and direct booking links.
mrtHtml: Phayao has no metro and no commercial airport — most people drive in themselves or take a coach to the bus terminal in the town centre. Hotels are fairly spread out, so pick by your itinerary: the lakeside at Ban Tom is quiet with lake views, a 10–15 minute drive into town, best with your own car; the town centre (Wiang) is walkable to the Chai Kwan lakefront, the Wat Tilok Aram pier, the markets and the bus terminal; and Chiang Kham district is about an hour from town, handy for Wat Nantaram and the Phu Sang waterfall. Almost every hotel has free parking, so they suit self-drivers well.

entries.name: Phuglong Hotel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Chai Kwan Rd · town centre · lake views
entries.addr: 888 Chai Kwan Road, Wiang, Mueang Phayao
entries.storyHtml: Phuglong is the most-reviewed hotel in Phayao — 371 reviews, scoring 8.9. It sits on Chai Kwan Road in the heart of town, within walking distance of the lakefront, and some rooms have a balcony overlooking the lake. Rooms run a generous ~30 sqm with big windows, and prices start at just ฿850 — well-judged for a central, lake-view spot like this.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a higher floor on the lake side when you book — the morning view over the water is the best, and you can stroll straight out to the lakefront.
pros: Most reviewed hotel in Phayao (371) — plenty to go on
Central Chai Kwan Road, walkable to the lakefront
Some rooms have a lake-view balcony
Roomy ~30 sqm rooms, well-priced from ฿850
cons: Lake-view rooms are limited — request one when booking
A town building, so no quiet resort atmosphere

entries.name: ABIZZ Hotel KwanPhayao
entries.storyHtml: ABIZZ is a lakeside hotel where a lake-view room with a balcony starts at just ฿790, scoring 9.0 from 110 reviews. It sits on the Ban Tom side right by Kwan Phayao; the Lake View rooms have a private balcony facing the water, and there's a lift and free parking. With rates from ฿650, it's a sensible pick for the lakeside — ideal if you have a car and want to wake up to the water.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Just book the Double Lake View with a balcony — it's only a few hundred baht more than a standard room but gives you the full lake view.
pros: Lake-view rooms with a balcony from ฿790
Scores 9.0 from a solid 110 reviews
Lift and free parking
Rates from just ฿650 for a lakeside spot
cons: On the Ban Tom side — a 10–15 minute drive into town
Buffet breakfast costs extra, not included in the room

entries.name: Hop Inn Phayao
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Tha Kwan Rd · near Kwan Phayao · town centre
tags: 🚶 Tha Kwan Rd, near the lake
entries.addr: 53/11 Tha Kwan Road, Wiang, Mueang Phayao
entries.storyHtml: Hop Inn is a budget chain hotel that scores a high 9.4 from 109 reviews. The appeal is consistency — clean rooms, comfy beds, a price that fits a budget, no frills but everything you need. It's on Tha Kwan Road in the town centre near Kwan Phayao, walkable to the lakefront and the markets, ideal for a single-night stop or a stopover on a longer trip.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a Standard with Balcony on a higher floor — a few of them catch a glimpse of the lake, and it's only a touch more than a standard room.
pros: 9.4 — the highest score among this guide's budget options
Reliable chain standard: clean rooms, comfy beds every time
Central, near the lake and walkable to the markets
Rates from ฿650 keep the budget in check
cons: A budget chain — rooms are plain, no decorative flourish
No breakfast on-site, so you'll head out to eat

entries.name: KM Kwanphayao Hotel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Lampang Rd · Wiang · near the lake
entries.storyHtml: KM Kwanphayao is a town hotel that throws in both a buffet breakfast and free bikes, scoring 8.9 from 141 reviews. It's on Lampang Road in Wiang, near Kwan Phayao, so you can cycle along the lake with ease. There's a large ~100 sqm Family Room for groups and free parking, with rates from just ฿650.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Borrow the hotel's free bikes and ride along Kwan Phayao in the morning — the air is cool and the lake views are lovely.
pros: Buffet breakfast and free bikes in one price
Scores 8.9 from a solid 141 reviews
Big Family Room, great for families or groups
Near the lake — cycle along the water
cons: Plain building and rooms — no design focus
Standard rooms are compact at around 25 sqm

entries.name: Rico Resort Chiang Kham
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Chiang Kham district · ~1 hr from town
entries.storyHtml: Rico Resort is a garden resort on the Chiang Kham side, with an outdoor pool and a tennis court, scoring 9.1 from 53 reviews. The draw is the wide garden grounds with a pond, a gym and an on-site restaurant — a quiet place to unwind. It's a smart base if you're exploring Wat Nantaram or the Phu Sang waterfall, so you don't have to drive back to Phayao town every day.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Travelling as a group or family? Look at the Three-Bedroom Villa — split per head it works out far cheaper, and you get the pool and garden to enjoy.
pros: Outdoor pool, tennis court, gym and a big garden
Scores 9.1, with a quiet, restful feel
A three-bedroom villa, great for groups/families
Well-placed for the Chiang Kham–Phu Sang side
cons: In Chiang Kham, about an hour from Phayao town
Starting rate is noticeably higher than town hotels

entries.name: M2 Hotel Waterside
entries.storyHtml: M2 Hotel Waterside is a 4-star lakeside hotel with a rooftop overlooking the lake and a swimming pool, scoring 8.3. It's the highest star tier in this guide; the appeal is the Lake View rooms with big windows facing the water and the rooftop space for watching the sunset. It's on the Ban Tom side, ideal if you have a car and want the full lakeside atmosphere.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Pick a Lake View room and head up to the rooftop in the evening — the sunset over Kwan Phayao is the highlight here.
pros: 4-star — the highest star tier in this guide
Rooftop with lake views + a swimming pool
Lake View rooms with big windows onto the water
Full lakeside atmosphere on the Ban Tom side
cons: Still few reviews (36) as it opened recently
On the Ban Tom side — you'll drive into town

entries.name: Naga Tara Boutique Resort
entries.storyHtml: Naga Tara is a lakeside boutique resort with a Honeymoon Pool Villa and lake-view villas, scoring 8.4. It sits on the Ban Tom side by Kwan Phayao, with a swimming pool and villa-grade rooms facing the lake — ideal for couples after a private spot by the water. Standard rooms start at ฿1,100, with the Pool Villa from ฿2,800 if you're marking a special occasion.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Celebrating with your partner? Book the Honeymoon Pool Villa with its lake view; for an ordinary stay the Standard King is good value.
pros: Has a swimming pool and lake-view villas
Honeymoon Pool Villa, ideal for couples
Quiet, private lakeside atmosphere
Standard rooms from just ฿1,100
cons: Still few reviews (20), so less data to go on
On the Ban Tom side — you'll drive into town

entries.name: Dee Hotel Phayao
entries.addr: 989 Moo 12, Phahonyothin Road, Ban Tom, Mueang Phayao
entries.storyHtml: Dee Hotel is a budget hotel with rooms bigger than the price suggests, from just ฿620, scoring 8.9 from 43 reviews. Superior rooms run about 24 sqm, with the Deluxe stepping up to 28 sqm and some adding a balcony. It's on Phahonyothin Road on the Ban Tom side, easy in and out of town, with a two-bedroom Family Room for families — ideal for budget travellers who still want room to breathe.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If your budget stretches a little, go for the Deluxe Double at 28 sqm — it's roomier, some have a balcony, and it's better value than the Superior.
pros: From ฿620 but roomy at 24–28 sqm
Scores 8.9, strong for the budget tier
Has a two-bedroom Family Room
On Phahonyothin Road, easy in and out of town
cons: On a main road — some rooms may catch traffic noise
The Booking link is a search page, not the hotel page direct

entries.name: I Ya Guesthouse
entries.storyHtml: I Ya Guesthouse is a small guesthouse with the highest review score in this guide — 9.8 (from 16 reviews). The appeal is the cleanliness, the big bathrooms and attentive hosts, all in a quiet setting on the Mae Puem outskirts. There are only about four rooms, with parking right outside — ideal if you have a car and value a clean, quiet stay over a central location.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: With only about four rooms and such a high score, it fills fast — book ahead, especially over long weekends.
pros: Review score of 9.8 — the highest in this guide
Very clean, big bathrooms, attentive hosts
Quiet, restful setting on the outskirts
Parking right by your room, handy for drivers
cons: On the Mae Puem outskirts, not in the town centre
Only about four rooms — fills fast, book ahead

entries.name: M2 Hotel Phayao
entries.revCount: 57 reviews · cheapest of the town hotels
entries.addr: 23/3 Pratu Klong 1 Road, Wiang, Mueang Phayao
entries.storyHtml: M2 Hotel is the cheapest of the town hotels here (dorms aside), from just ฿700, scoring 8.2 from 57 reviews. It's on Pratu Klong 1 Road in the heart of Phayao, walkable to the markets and the lakefront. There's free parking, free Wi-Fi and the Happy Mori Cafe for breakfast — ideal for budget travellers who want to stay central without a car.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Rates climb to ฿880 over long weekends — book ahead on a weekday to lock in the ฿700 starting rate.
pros: From ฿700 — cheapest of the town hotels
Central, walkable to the markets and lakefront
Happy Mori Cafe on-site for breakfast
Free parking and free Wi-Fi
cons: Scores 8.2 — rooms are plain for the price
Rates rise noticeably over long weekends

entries.name: The Cozy Nest Boutique Rooms
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Ratchawong Rd · town centre · walk to the lake
entries.storyHtml: The Cozy Nest is a boutique-styled guesthouse in the town centre, within walking distance of Kwan Phayao, scoring 8.3 from 14 reviews. It's on Ratchawong Road, with boutique-styled rooms of about 20 sqm, clean, from ฿700. The appeal is the central location for those without a car — you can walk to the lakefront, the markets and the restaurants — ideal for couples or solo travellers who like a small place with character.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If your budget allows, pick the Superior King — it's roomier and the boutique styling is more pronounced than in the Deluxe rooms.
pros: Central location, walkable to Kwan Phayao
Boutique styling, clean rooms
From ฿700, ideal for couples/solo travellers
Walk to the markets and restaurants
cons: Only about 14 rooms — fills fast over festivals
Rooms at ~20 sqm are compact, tight for big luggage

entries.name: ME HUG Guesthouse and Hostel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Opposite the bus terminal · near the lake · town centre
tags: 🚶 Near the lake, walk into town
entries.addr: 12/61 Rob Wiang Pratu Klong Road, Wiang, Mueang Phayao
entries.storyHtml: ME HUG is the cheapest stay in this guide — dorm beds from just ฿250, scoring 8.3. It's right across from the Phayao bus terminal, near the lake and the town centre, ideal for travellers arriving by coach who can walk straight to their bed. There are single-sex dorms with lockers and private Twin/Double rooms for those who want their own space — ideal for backpackers and solo travellers.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Solo? The ฿250 dorm bed is the cheapest option. Travelling as a pair, the ฿450 Twin works out about the same split between you — and you get the privacy.
pros: Cheapest in this guide — dorm beds from ฿250
Opposite the bus terminal, walk in from the coach
Single-sex dorms with lockers
Private Twin/Double rooms also available
cons: A hostel — dorms mean sharing space with others
Still few reviews (12) and limited private rooms

adviceTitle: How to pick the right Phayao hotel for you

advice.head: On a tight budget, want the best value
advice.bodyHtml: → ME HUG, dorm beds from ฿250 opposite the bus terminal · or Dee Hotel ฿620 with rooms bigger than the price · or Hop Inn ฿650, a budget chain scoring 9.4

advice.head: Want to stay lakeside, with a water view
advice.bodyHtml: → ABIZZ Hotel KwanPhayao ฿650 with lake-view balcony rooms · or M2 Hotel Waterside ฿1,200, 4-star with a rooftop lake view

advice.head: No car, want to stay central
advice.bodyHtml: → Phuglong Hotel ฿850 on Chai Kwan Rd, walk to the lakefront · or The Cozy Nest ฿700, a boutique on Ratchawong Rd, walk to the lake

advice.head: Couples' trip, after a private feel
advice.bodyHtml: → Naga Tara Boutique Resort ฿1,100 with a Honeymoon Pool Villa and lake view · a quiet, private feel by the water

advice.head: Travelling as a family or group
advice.bodyHtml: → KM Kwanphayao ฿650 with a big Family Room + free bikes · or Rico Resort Chiang Kham ฿1,800 with a three-bedroom villa + pool

advice.head: Exploring the Chiang Kham–Phu Sang side
advice.bodyHtml: → Rico Resort Chiang Kham ฿1,800, a garden resort with a pool and tennis court — no need to drive back to town every day

advice.head: Want the highest review score, peace and quiet
advice.bodyHtml: → I Ya Guesthouse ฿700, scoring 9.8, very clean, quiet on the Mae Puem outskirts · ideal for drivers who value a clean, quiet stay

noteHtml: 📌 Note: All prices are approximate and can change by date and season — always check the live rate and compare 3 sites before booking. Over long weekends, festivals and the cool season (Nov–Jan), when the weather is at its best, rates rise and rooms fill fast, so book 2–4 weeks ahead. faqTitle: FAQ — Common traveller questions about Phayao hotels

faq.q: ❓ Which area should I stay in Phayao?
faq.a: It depends on whether you have a car. The lakeside at Ban Tom is quiet with lake views, best with a car (ABIZZ, M2 Waterside, Naga Tara). The town centre in Wiang is walkable to the Chai Kwan lakefront, the markets and the bus terminal, best without a car (Phuglong, Hop Inn, M2 Hotel, Cozy Nest, ME HUG). Chiang Kham district is about an hour from town, handy for Wat Nantaram and Phu Sang (Rico Resort).

faq.q: ❓ How much do Phayao hotels cost?
faq.a: Phayao is very wallet-friendly: dorm beds from around ฿250 (ME HUG); budget 2–3 star town hotels around ฿620–900 (Hop Inn, Dee, M2, KM, Cozy Nest); lakeside boutiques around ฿1,100–1,500 (Naga Tara, M2 Waterside, ABIZZ lake-view rooms); and a garden resort in Chiang Kham from ฿1,800 (Rico).

faq.q: ❓ Can I stay in Phayao without a car?
faq.a: Yes, if you pick a town-centre stay in Wiang. ME HUG is opposite the bus terminal, so you can walk straight in from the coach. Phuglong, Hop Inn, M2 Hotel and The Cozy Nest are central, walkable to the Chai Kwan lakefront, the markets and the Wat Tilok Aram pier. But for the Ban Tom lakeside or for exploring Chiang Kham, you'll want a car or a rented motorbike.

faq.q: ❓ Which Phayao hotels have a swimming pool?
faq.a: In this guide, the ones with a pool are M2 Hotel Waterside (pool + rooftop lake view), Naga Tara Boutique Resort (lakeside pool + Pool Villa) on the Ban Tom side, and Rico Resort Chiang Kham (outdoor pool + tennis court) on the Chiang Kham side.

faq.q: ❓ Where can I book a Kwan Phayao lake-view room?
faq.a: The best-value lake-view room is at ABIZZ Hotel KwanPhayao — a Lake View room with a balcony from around ฿790. For ฿1,500, M2 Hotel Waterside has Lake View rooms with big windows and a rooftop overlooking the lake. Specify a lake-view room when booking, as they're limited.

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should I book a Phayao hotel?
faq.a: For ordinary weekdays, 1–2 weeks ahead is plenty. But over long weekends, festivals and the cool season (Nov–Jan), when northern travel peaks, lakeside rooms and the small-room stays like I Ya Guesthouse or The Cozy Nest fill fast — book 2–4 weeks ahead.
